liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Wheel** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer says this version is memorable only because it was the band's final performance of the song; The Wheel comes out of Drums and Space in the second set [3][11]
- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Schoolgirl as a highlight of the song selection [8]
- **Throwin Stones** (1 other source): Throwing Stones leads straight into Not Fade Away to close the second set [3]
- **The Mighty Quinn** (1 review): Reviewer insists the band played U.S. Blues rather than Quinn the Eskimo, contradicting the setlist [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **Pretty Peggy-O**: back after 1272 archived shows (6059 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-05-25.pzm.russjcan.97640.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 151 min [1]
- **gd95-05-25.neumann.18801.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 2.22/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording's sound not great, though remembers a solid show [12]
- **gd1995-05-25.neumann.vernon.8481.shnf**: source not stated; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1995-05-25.nuemannKM140.unknown.larson.35154.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's last time seeing the band, standing about 20 yards away; heard the next day's show from outside the stadium [8]
- Reviewer attended all three Seattle shows and felt Jerry played poorly [9]
- Reviewer got in on the guest list, the only one of about 90 shows seen that way, and it was their last show [10]
- Reviewer stayed in the field after the show and heard Phish's Stash played in the parking lot [19]
- Reviewer prefers this show to the 26th because of the song choices [8]
- Reviewer calls the next night's much-praised show barely adequate and rates Spring Tour better than this run [9]
- Reviewer says this show belonged to the Spring tour [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-05-25.pzm.russjcan.97640.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Hat Mounted Realistic PZM's with Sony WMD6-C 50 feet away,Dead center Sony Metal-SR 100 no nr [1]
- **gd95-05-25.neumann.18801.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Ross M. and Chris Larson; source: Audience: Neumann KM140's [3]
- **gd1995-05-25.neumann.vernon.8481.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Neumann KM 140 > ? CDR > EAC(secure) > mkwact(seekable) [4]. Also: Taped front of board by Dominic Tringale and Roger Jones with Neumann KM 140 mics, Aerco preamp, Sony D-10; Mic capsules were hidden in a mesh baseball hat, set in a 110-degree ORTF pattern [14]
- **gd1995-05-25.nuemannKM140.unknown.larson.35154.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: Af:Nueman KM140>DAT(48kHz) [5]. Also: Dominic Tringale and Roger Jones taped it front of board: Neumann KM140s into an Aerco preamp, then a Sony D-10 Pro [15]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-05-25 Memorial Stadium, Seattle, WA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-05-25-memorial-stadium-seattle-wa-usa/) [21]
